name: design-app-tauri-rust-svelte
description: A modular software-engineering assistant for researching, architecting, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining desktop applications with Tauri 2, Rust, Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite, and optionally SvelteKit.

interface.longDescription: A private, autonomous, modular software-engineering assistant. It coordinates six specialized skills to discover requirements, research technical choices, design modular architecture, implement frontend and backend, analyze quality, manage delivery, and maintain complete project documentation.
defaultPrompt: Help me design and build a desktop application from scratch with Tauri 2, Rust, and Svelte.
Inspect my existing Tauri and Svelte project, plan the next implementation slice, and execute it safely.
Review my application architecture, code quality, security, tests, and release readiness.
